brief.question: When should an enterprise knowledge assistant choose RAG, long context or a hybrid?
brief.audience: Product and technical leads of an enterprise knowledge assistant.
brief.scope: Compare document updates, permissions, citation location, answer quality, latency and cost using primary papers and technical documentation available as of execution.
brief.output: final.md: a complete English report, 3000–4000 whitespace-delimited words across the whole file including Markdown, citations and references; separate source, claim and review records.
brief.depth: Develop evidence, comparisons and counterevidence by section, with conditional recommendations and first steps. Treat unspecified organization size, budget and deployment conditions as assumptions to verify.
brief.evidence_standard: Read primary sources, record the information cutoff at execution, cite source titles and URLs, and revise the complete report using the chosen review tier.
